Find Organization Names Shared Across Lobbying Registers

eulob_cross_registers.Rd

Identify names occurring in multiple territorial lobbying registers in the bundled EU-LOB catalogue.

Usage

eulob_cross_registers(name = NULL, min_countries = 2L, limit = NULL)

Arguments

name

Optional organization name for exact normalized matching. Matching is case-insensitive, but not fuzzy.

min_countries

Positive integer specifying the minimum number of territorial scopes. Default is 2.

limit

Optional positive integer limiting distinct names.

Value

A data frame containing name_id, name, country, register, lobby_id, n_countries and n_entities.

Details

Matching uses normalized organization names and existing name identifiers. A shared name is not proof that registrations refer to the same legal entity.

The EU Transparency Register ("UE") counts as a separate scope. The limit is applied to names, not registration rows.

See also

[eulob_lobbies()], [eulob_search()]

Examples

eulob_cross_registers(limit = 5)
